headline_item.title_zh: 中美达成AI军事决策人工管控共识
headline_item.title_en: Trump, Xi agreed humans must stay in charge of AI military decisions, Bessent says
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 美国总统特朗普与中国国家主席习近平在深圳会晤期间，明确AI军事决策需保留人类参与，严禁超级智能自主执行重大军事行动
headline_item.event_summary_en: U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed during their meeting at the APEC summit in Shenzhen that humans must maintain control over military decisions involving artificial intelligence, prohibiting autonomous 'superintelligence' (SI) in major military actions, as confirmed by U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. The leaders also engaged in robust discussions regarding nuclear non-proliferation, trade policy, and the Russia-Ukraine conflict, culminating in a joint declaration emphasizing that nuclear war must never be fought.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平、美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特在中国深圳亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会：确立AI军事决策人工管控红线，禁止超级智能自主执行重大作战指令
【起因与机理】在全球地缘博弈背景下，为防止AI军事应用失控引发非预期的全球冲突
【核心事实细节】美中领导人达成AI军事决策必须有人类介入的共识。
【各方立场与态度】同步签署核战争不可赢且必须避免发生的联合声明。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent (APEC Summit, Shenzhen, China): Established a 'human-in-the-loop' requirement for AI-driven military decisions
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To prevent accidental escalation and ensure strategic stability in AI-enabled warfare
[Key Fact Detail] US-China consensus on human-in-the-loop for AI military decisions.
[Key Position & Outlook] Joint declaration on the necessity of avoiding nuclear conflict.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 将AI军事决策的“人类介入权”确立为大国博弈的底线红线，意味着AI军备竞赛正式从单纯的技术压制转向规则架构的抢滩战。该共识实质性地设定了AI武器化开发的合规边界，未来全球国防工业将重点布局“可解释与可中断”的AI架构，以确保战略博弈的物理可控性，防止算法黑箱触发不可逆的军事对抗。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Establishing a 'human-in-the-loop' mandate for AI military decisions shifts the arms race from pure performance metrics to structural governance control. This consensus creates a hard compliance floor for global defense contractors, forcing future AI weapon systems to prioritize deterministic 'kill-switch' architectures to prevent algorithmic-induced military escalation.

headlines.title_zh: 人择数学家声称已经与克劳德解决了久负盛名的千年奖问题
headlines.title_en: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
headlines.event_summary_zh: 人择数学家莱文特·阿尔波格 (Levent Alpöge) 声称，他在克劳德的帮助下证明了黎曼猜想，这是数学中最臭名昭著的难题之一，破解了数十年来世界上一些最优秀数学家一直未能解决的难题。如果得到证实，这将标志着人工智能的又一重大成就
headlines.event_summary_en:
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics’s most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world’s best mathematicians for decades. If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics and add to the upheaval already unleashed by OpenAI’s previous, often inelegant forays into the field.

Alpöge’s solution has yet to be verified independently. Anthro

headlines.title_zh: AI代理通信设施服务商Linq获9000万美元B轮融资
headlines.title_en: Linq, which offers texting and calling infrastructure for AI agents, raised a $90M Series B led by a16z, following a $20M Series A in February (Harper Harwell/Birmingham Business Journal)
headlines.event_summary_zh:
哈珀·哈威尔/伯明翰商业杂志：
Linq 为 AI 代理提供短信和呼叫基础设施，继 2 月份筹集了 2000 万美元的 A 轮融资后，又筹集了由 a16z 领投的 9000 万美元的 B 轮融资——就在几个月后，Birmingh 的一家公司进行了一轮重大的 A 轮融资
headlines.event_summary_en: Linq, a provider of specialized communication infrastructure for AI agents, has secured $90 million in Series B funding led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). This financing follows a $20 million Series A round in February, underscoring rapid capital deployment into the foundational connectivity layer of the AI agent ecosystem.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Linq（AI代理通信设施服务商）、Andreessen Horowitz (a16z，领投方)在一级市场投融资渠道：完成9000万美元B轮融资，用于扩展AI代理间文本与呼叫通信基础设施
【起因与机理】AI代理从单点任务向协同执行演进，驱动对底层通信协议与连接能力的需求
【关键数据与实测】Linq公司获得由a16z领投的9000万美元B轮融资。
【各方立场与态度】资本市场近期对AI代理生态协同化、工程化工具的支持力度显著提升。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Linq, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) (Venture capital market): Raised $90M in Series B to scale texting and calling infrastructure for AI agents
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Rising demand for interoperable communication protocols as AI agents transition from solo tasks to collaborative workflows
[Key Metrics] Linq secured $90M Series B funding led by a16z.
[Key Position & Outlook] Strong market acceleration in support for multi-agent interoperability and engineering tooling.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: AI代理的价值边界已从单一模型能力转向多智能体协同，Linq的融资折射出基础设施层正经历从纯算力向通信协议转化的结构性机会。投资人正押注AI代理集群的“去中心化通信”架构，以应对未来Agent-to-Agent（A2A）复杂交互带来的高并发合规与链路调度需求。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The value boundary for AI agents is shifting from single-model capabilities to multi-agent collaboration, highlighting a structural opportunity in communication infrastructure. Investors are betting on decentralized communication architectures to manage the complexities of future high-concurrency Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interactions and compliance requirements.

celebrity.author: Yann LeCun
celebrity.author_role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
celebrity.quote_zh:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun 正则化器只是指定归纳偏差的一种方法。

您的模型架构和您使用的优化过程已经存在归纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
celebrity.quote_en:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify an inductive bias.

The architecture of your model, and the optimization procedure you use already have inductive biases: they like to produce certain functions more than others.

A regularizer merely imposes another bias.

Learning theory tells you that you have to have an inductive bias, otherwise you can't learn anything with a reasonable number of samples or trials (VC theory, no free lunch theorems).

So, conceptually, theoretically, philosophically, and practically, there is nothing wrong with regularizers.
